_about: Page-level pass over every RecentChanges-style Archive capture of wikiservice.at and dorfwiki.org, 2026-05-12..2026-06-22 (index in wayback_cdx_sweep_2026-09-06.json; captures read 2026-09-07 via id_ raw replay). Each row is one RecentChanges line (wiki, date, page, time as printed, author, summary) deduplicated across captures; first_capture is the earliest Archive timestamp that shows it. Classification against the collusion.wiki export: export_wiki_row_not_in_export = wiki in the export, (page, author) pair absent; export_wiki_new_handle_and_page = neither handle nor page appears in that wiki's export; non_export_wiki = wiki not in the export at all. Human operators and non-signature authors are excluded from the classified lists. Read-only.
